gizmo.title: Chọpụta ebe ndị ahụ
gizmo.description: Ndị mmụta na-achọta ebe ziri ezi na onyonyo site n'ịpị, imetụ ma ọ bụ ịkpali crosshair kiibọọdụ. Ụdị nwere akara nke maapụ onyonyo.

configure.title: Onyonyo
configure.description: Foto ndị mmụta na-achọ n'ime ya.

configure.title: Ederede nnọchi
configure.description: Na-akọwa foto ahụ maka ndị na-enweghị ike ịhụ ya. A naghị egosi ya dịka aha ma ọlị.

configure.title: Aha
configure.description: Aha dị mkpụmkpụ a na-ahụ anya e gosiri n'elu foto ahụ.

configure.title: Ajụjụ
configure.description: Ihe a na-ajụ ndị mmụta ka ha chọta na foto ahụ.

configure.title: Azịza
configure.description: Azịza ọ bụla bụ oval nwere aha na foto ahụ. Ọnọdụ na nha bụ pasentị nke foto ahụ, a tụrụ site na nkuku elu aka ekpe ya. Mgbe a na-edezi, a na-akpụchi azịza ọ bụla na foto ahụ.

advanced.title: Ngbalị
advanced.description: Ugboro ole onye mmụta nwere ike ịnwa. 0 pụtara enweghị oke.

advanced.title: Ntụfu ekwere
advanced.description: Ntụfu ole na-akwụsị ngbalị. 0 pụtara enweghị oke, ndị mmụta na-enwetakwa bọtịnụ Mechaa.

advanced.title: Enwere ike ịkpachi
advanced.description: Gosi ajụjụ a dịka ahịrị na-emeghe ma na-emechi. Imeghe otu na-emechi ajụjụ ndị ọzọ enwere ike ịkpachi dị n'akụkụ ya.

advanced.title: Malite emechiri emechi
advanced.description: Mgbe enwere ike ịkpachi, malite dịka ahịrị emechiri emechi na-egosi naanị ajụjụ na ọnọdụ ya.

advanced.title: Ụdị akara
advanced.description: OER Schema: ụdị akara maka nyocha a (dịka akara, mkpụrụedemede, pasentị, mmecha).

advanced.title: Ebumnuche mmụta
advanced.description: OER Schema: ebumnuche mmụta metụtara nyocha a.

developer.title: Aha ajụjụ ule
developer.description: Aha ajụjụ ule enyere maka ojiji na gburugburu xAPI iji chọpụta ihe a

developer.title: Ọmụmụ
developer.description: OER Schema: ọmụmụ e bu n'obi maka nyocha a.
